description:
Log in to ManageEngine ServiceDesk Plus as 'administrator' (password: 'administrator'). Navigate to the Admin settings area (Incident Management > Helpdesk > Category) and configure the incident categorization hierarchy.

1. Create a new top-level Category named exactly 'Cloud Services'.
2. Under this new 'Cloud Services' category, add the following three Subcategories:
   - Provisioning
   - Performance Issues
   - Access Management

Ensure all items are saved. The final state should show 'Cloud Services' in the category list with these three subcategories nested under it.
